Infused with 100 mg of high-quality live rosin, these gummies offer the full spectrum benefits of cannabis-derived terpenes for enhanced effects and authenticity. The hybrid classification provides a balanced experience that can promote relaxation, creativity, and uplifted mood without being too sedating or stimulating. Perfect for both recreational enjoyment and therapeutic relief, Kanha Belts are precisely dosed for consistent, reliable results every time. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or seeking creative inspiration, these strain-specific gummies deliver potent effects with exceptional flavor in every bite.
